```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!exists("normalize_model_names")) {
  normalize_model_names <- function(mod_list) {
    if (is.null(mod_list) || length(mod_list) == 0) return(mod_list)
    if (is.character(mod_list)) {
      mod_list[mod_list == "DNN_Profunda"]     <- "MLP"
      mod_list[mod_list == "DNN_Regularizada"] <- "MLP_Regularizado"
      mod_list[mod_list %in% c("DNN_Autoencoder", "Autoencoder", "SAE-DNN", "SAE_DNN")] <- "Stacked Autoencoder - DNN"
      return(mod_list)
    }
    nms <- names(mod_list)
    if (!is.null(nms)) {
      nms[nms == "DNN_Profunda"]     <- "MLP"
      nms[nms == "DNN_Regularizada"] <- "MLP_Regularizado"
      nms[nms %in% c("DNN_Autoencoder", "Autoencoder", "SAE-DNN", "SAE_DNN")] <- "Stacked Autoencoder - DNN"
      names(mod_list) <- nms
      mod_list <- mod_list[!duplicated(names(mod_list))]
    }
    mod_list
  }
}

# Indice Global con fuerte peso en FDR (mismo criterio que training_report.qmd)
compute_global_fdr_score <- function(df_row) {
  fdr_v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_row$FDR[1]))
  f1_v   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_row$F1_Score[1]))
  mcc_v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_row$MCC[1]))
  bacc_v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_row$Exactitud_Balanceada[1]))
  auc_v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df_row$ROC_AUC[1]))

  if (length(fdr_v) == 0  || is.na(fdr_v))  fdr_v  <- 1.0
  if (length(f1_v) == 0   || is.na(f1_v))   f1_v   <- 0.0
  if (length(mcc_v) == 0  || is.na(mcc_v))  mcc_v  <- 0.0
  if (length(bacc_v) == 0 || is.na(bacc_v)) bacc_v <- 0.0
  if (length(auc_v) == 0  || is.na(auc_v))  auc_v  <- 0.0

  0.45 * (1 - fdr_v) + 0.20 * f1_v + 0.15 * mcc_v + 0.10 * bacc_v + 0.10 * auc_v
}

fmt_fdr_pct <- function(val) {
  if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) "Sin pred. TP (NA)" else sprintf("%.2f%%", as.numeric(val) * 100)
}

# Formateador de tablas interactivas con asterisco (*) cuando la otra version de entrenamiento (Balanceado vs Desbalanceado) transfiere mejor
format_benchmark_dt <- function(df,
                                other_df = NULL,
                                current_scen = "Balanceado",
                                other_scen = "Desbalanceado",
                                caption_text = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_display <- df
  base_models <- as.character(df_display$Modelo)
  comp_notes  <- rep("Invariante (Regla fija)", nrow(df_display))
  flagged_vec <- rep(FALSE, nrow(df_display))

  has_other <- !is.null(other_df) && nrow(other_df) > 0 && "Modelo" %in% colnames(other_df)
  other_models <- if (has_other) as.character(other_df$Modelo) else character(0)

  if (has_other) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_display))) {
      m_name <- base_models[i]
      if (!is.na(m_name) && !isTRUE(grepl("^Youden_", m_name)) && m_name != "Weighted_Heuristic" && m_name %in% other_models) {
        row_curr  <- df[i, , drop = FALSE]
        row_other <- other_df[which(other_models == m_name)[1], , drop = FALSE]

        score_curr  <- compute_global_fdr_score(row_curr)
        score_other <- compute_global_fdr_score(row_other)
        fdr_curr    <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row_curr$FDR[1]))
        fdr_other   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row_other$FDR[1]))

        curr_fdr_na  <- (length(fdr_curr) == 0 || is.na(fdr_curr))
        other_fdr_na <- (length(fdr_other) == 0 || is.na(fdr_other))

        other_is_better <- FALSE
        curr_is_better  <- FALSE

        if (curr_fdr_na && !other_fdr_na) {
          other_is_better <- TRUE
        } else if (!curr_fdr_na && other_fdr_na) {
          curr_is_better <- TRUE
        } else if (!curr_fdr_na && !other_fdr_na) {
          other_is_better <- isTRUE(
            (score_other > score_curr + 1e-4 && fdr_other <= fdr_curr + 0.005) ||
            (fdr_other < fdr_curr - 1e-4 && score_other >= score_curr - 0.002)
          )
          curr_is_better <- !other_is_better && isTRUE(
            score_curr > score_other + 1e-4 || fdr_curr < fdr_other - 1e-4
          )
        } else {
          other_is_better <- isTRUE(score_other > score_curr + 1e-4)
          curr_is_better  <- isTRUE(score_curr > score_other + 1e-4)
        }

        if (isTRUE(other_is_better)) {
          df_display$Modelo[i] <- paste0(m_name, " *")
          flagged_vec[i] <- TRUE
          comp_notes[i] <- sprintf(
            "* Mejor desde %s (FDR: %s vs %s | Índice: %.3f vs %.3f)",
            other_scen, fmt_fdr_pct(fdr_other), fmt_fdr_pct(fdr_curr), score_other, score_curr
          )
        } else if (isTRUE(curr_is_better)) {
          comp_notes[i] <- sprintf(
            "Óptimo desde %s (FDR: %s vs %s | Índice: %.3f vs %.3f)",
            current_scen, fmt_fdr_pct(fdr_curr), fmt_fdr_pct(fdr_other), score_curr, score_other
          )
        } else {
          comp_notes[i] <- sprintf(
            "Equivalente en ambos (FDR: %s)",
            fmt_fdr_pct(fdr_curr)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  df_display <- df_display %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Mejor_Version_FDR = comp_notes, .after = "Modelo")

  pct_cols <- intersect(
    c("Exactitud", "Exactitud_Balanceada", "Sensibilidad", "Especificidad", "Precision", "VPN", "FDR"),
    colnames(df_display)
  )
  dec_cols <- intersect(
    c("F1_Score", "MCC", "Kappa", "ROC_AUC"),
    colnames(df_display)
  )

  for (col in pct_cols) {
    df_display[[col]] <- round(as.numeric(df_display[[col]]) * 100, 2)
  }
  for (col in dec_cols) {
    df_display[[col]] <- round(as.numeric(df_display[[col]]), 3)
  }

  dt <- DT::datatable(
    df_display,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = caption_text,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 50,
      lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
      scrollX = TRUE,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "copy",  text = "Copiar Tabla",   exportOptions = list(modifier = list(page = "all"))),
        list(extend = "csv",   text = "Exportar CSV",   exportOptions = list(modifier = list(page = "all"))),
        list(extend = "excel", text = "Exportar Excel", exportOptions = list(modifier = list(page = "all")))
      ),
      language = list(
        search = "Filtrar modelo:",
        zeroRecords = "No se encontraron registros",
        emptyTable = "Sin datos"
      )
    )
  )

  if (length(pct_cols) > 0) {
    dt <- dt %>% DT::formatCurrency(columns = pct_cols, currency = "%", before = FALSE, digits = 2)
  }
  if (length(dec_cols) > 0) {
    dt <- dt %>% DT::formatRound(columns = dec_cols, digits = 3)
  }
  if (any(flagged_vec)) {
    flagged_names <- df_display$Modelo[flagged_vec]
    dt <- dt %>% DT::formatStyle(
      "Modelo",
      color = DT::styleEqual(flagged_names, rep("#b9770e", length(flagged_names))),
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(flagged_names, rep("#fef9e7", length(flagged_names))),
      fontWeight = DT::styleEqual(flagged_names, rep("bold", length(flagged_names)))
    )
  }
  if ("F1_Score" %in% colnames(df_display)) {
    dt <- dt %>% DT::formatStyle(
      "F1_Score",
      background = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#a9cce3"),
      backgroundSize = "95% 75%",
      backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
      backgroundPosition = "center",
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
  }
  if ("ROC_AUC" %in% colnames(df_display)) {
    dt <- dt %>% DT::formatStyle(
      "ROC_AUC",
      background = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#a3e4d7"),
      backgroundSize = "95% 75%",
      backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
      backgroundPosition = "center"
    )
  }
  return(dt)
}

# Selecciona los 6 modelos clave (Top 2 Youden + Heuristico + Top 3 ML sin Ensamble_Stacking ni Consenso_7_Modelos)
get_top6_summary_models <- function(bench_df) {
  if (is.null(bench_df) || nrow(bench_df) == 0) return(character(0))

  top2_youden <- bench_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^Youden_", Modelo)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 2) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Modelo)

  heur_name <- intersect("Weighted_Heuristic", bench_df$Modelo)

  top3_ml <- bench_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^Youden_", Modelo) & !Modelo %in% c("Weighted_Heuristic", "Ensamble_Stacking", "Consenso_7_Modelos")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Modelo)

  selected_6 <- unique(c(top2_youden, heur_name, top3_ml))

  if (length(selected_6) < 6) {
    extra_models <- bench_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!Modelo %in% c(selected_6, "Ensamble_Stacking", "Consenso_7_Modelos")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Modelo)
    selected_6 <- unique(c(selected_6, extra_models))[seq_len(min(6L, length(unique(c(selected_6, extra_models)))))]
  }

  bench_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Modelo %in% selected_6) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Modelo)
}

# Selecciona los 9 modelos estandarizados de transferencia de Workflow_Central_Sin_Rescate.R (lineas 1750-1881)
get_thesis_9_models <- function(bench_df) {
  if (is.null(bench_df) || nrow(bench_df) == 0) return(character(0))
  canonical_9 <- c(
    "Youden_pct_recovered",
    "Youden_pct_identity",
    "Weighted_Heuristic",
    "ElasticNet",
    "NaiveBayes",
    "SVM_Polinomial",
    "MLP",
    "LDA",
    "Ensamble_Stacking"
  )
  present_9 <- intersect(canonical_9, bench_df$Modelo)
  bench_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Modelo %in% present_9) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Modelo)
}

# Grafico interactivo Plotly ordenado de mayor a menor ROC-AUC
build_interactive_benchmark_plotly <- function(df_bench,
                                               species_title = "S. citrullifolium",
                                               view_label = "6 Modelos Clave") {
  if (is.null(df_bench) || nrow(df_bench) == 0) return(NULL)

  metrics_info <- list(
    list(col = "ROC_AUC",              label = "ROC-AUC",              color = "#27ae60"),
    list(col = "F1_Score",             label = "F1-Score",             color = "#2980b9"),
    list(col = "Exactitud_Balanceada", label = "Exactitud Balanceada", color = "#8e44ad"),
    list(col = "Exactitud",            label = "Exactitud (Accuracy)", color = "#16a085"),
    list(col = "Sensibilidad",         label = "Sensibilidad (TPR)",   color = "#d35400"),
    list(col = "Especificidad",        label = "Especificidad (TNR)",  color = "#2c3e50"),
    list(col = "Precision",            label = "Precisión (PPV)",      color = "#f39c12"),
    list(col = "FDR",                  label = "FDR (Falsos Pos.)",    color = "#c0392b"),
    list(col = "MCC",                  label = "MCC (Matthews)",       color = "#7f8c8d")
  )

  avail_info <- Filter(function(m) m$col %in% colnames(df_bench), metrics_info)
  if (length(avail_info) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_best_to_worst <- df_bench %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score))

  y_levels_bottom_to_top <- rev(unique(as.character(df_best_to_worst$Modelo)))
  df_sorted <- df_best_to_worst %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Modelo = factor(as.character(Modelo), levels = y_levels_bottom_to_top))

  n_models <- nrow(df_sorted)
  dynamic_height <- if (n_models <= 6) 560 else if (n_models <= 10) 720 else max(950, n_models * 82)

  fig <- plotly::plot_ly(height = dynamic_height)
  n_m <- length(avail_info)

  for (m in avail_info) {
    vals <- round(as.numeric(df_sorted[[m$col]]), 3)
    fig <- fig %>%
      plotly::add_trace(
        y = df_sorted$Modelo,
        x = vals,
        name = m$label,
        type = "bar",
        orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = m$color),
        text = sprintf("%.3f", vals),
        textposition = "auto",
        hovertemplate = paste0("<b>%{y}</b><br>", m$label, ": %{x:.3f}<extra></extra>")
      )
  }

  buttons_list <- list(
    list(
      method = "restyle",
      args = list("visible", as.list(rep(TRUE, n_m))),
      label = "Vista General (Todas las Métricas)"
    ),
    list(
      method = "restyle",
      args = list("visible", as.list(sapply(avail_info, function(x) x$col %in% c("F1_Score", "ROC_AUC", "Exactitud", "Precision", "Sensibilidad", "Especificidad", "FDR")))),
      label = "7 Métricas Clásicas"
    )
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n_m)) {
    vis_vec <- rep(FALSE, n_m)
    vis_vec[i] <- TRUE
    buttons_list[[length(buttons_list) + 1]] <- list(
      method = "restyle",
      args = list("visible", as.list(vis_vec)),
      label = paste("Solo:", avail_info[[i]]$label)
    )
  }

  fig <- fig %>%
    plotly::layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste0(
          "<b>Benchmark de Transferencia (", view_label, " — Ordenado por ROC-AUC) — ", species_title, "</b><br>",
          "<sup>Usa el botón desplegable para elegir métricas o haz clic en la leyenda inferior para activar/desactivar varias métricas</sup>"
        ),
        x = 0.5
      ),
      barmode = "group",
      bargap = 0.24,
      bargroupgap = 0.08,
      xaxis = list(title = "Puntaje (0 a 1)", range = c(0, 1.08), tickfont = list(size = 12)),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "",
        tickfont = list(size = 12),
        categoryorder = "array",
        categoryarray = y_levels_bottom_to_top
      ),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.08, x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", font = list(size = 11)),
      margin = list(l = 195, r = 35, t = 95, b = 105),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          active = 0,
          x = 0.0,
          y = 1.08,
          xanchor = "left",
          yanchor = "top",
          buttons = buttons_list
        )
      )
    )

  return(fig)
}

df_ml_donor <- if (!is.null(donor_df) && "Validacion_Espacial" %in% colnames(donor_df)) {
  pred_cols <- intersect(c("pct_recovered", "pct_identity", "score", "wscore"), colnames(donor_df))
  donor_df %>%

ensure_complete_tournament_models <- function(existing_list, df_train, sampling_mode = "down", target_rds_path = NULL) {
  existing_list <- normalize_model_names(existing_list)
  if (is.null(df_train) || nrow(df_train) < 10 || !exists("get_model_specs")) return(existing_list)

  specs <- get_model_specs(n_obs = nrow(df_train), extended = TRUE)
  missing_names <- setdiff(names(specs), names(existing_list))

  if (length(missing_names) == 0 && "Ensamble_Stacking" %in% names(existing_list)) {
    return(existing_list)
  }

  pred_cols <- intersect(c("pct_recovered", "pct_identity", "score", "wscore"), colnames(df_train))
  x_tr <- df_train[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]
  y_tr <- df_train$Clase

  ctrl <- caret::trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 5,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = caret::twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final",
    sampling = sampling_mode
  )

  for (m_name in missing_names) {
    cfg <- specs[[m_name]]
    set.seed(1234)
    args_list <- list(
      x = x_tr,
      y = y_tr,
      method = cfg$method,
      metric = "ROC",
      trControl = ctrl
    )
    if (!isTRUE(cfg$no_scale))   args_list$preProcess <- c("center", "scale")
    if (!is.null(cfg$tuneLength)) args_list$tuneLength <- cfg$tuneLength
    if (!is.null(cfg$tuneGrid))   args_list$tuneGrid   <- cfg$tuneGrid
    if (!is.null(cfg$trace))      args_list$trace      <- cfg$trace
    if (!is.null(cfg$MaxNWts))    args_list$MaxNWts    <- cfg$MaxNWts
    if (!is.null(cfg$verbose))    args_list$verbose    <- cfg$verbose
    if (!is.null(cfg$nthread))    args_list$nthread    <- cfg$nthread

    fit_m <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(capture.output(res_m <- do.call(caret::train, args_list))),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (exists("res_m") && !is.null(res_m)) {
      existing_list[[m_name]] <- res_m
      rm(res_m)
    }
  }

  if (!"Ensamble_Stacking" %in% names(existing_list) && requireNamespace("caretEnsemble", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stack_fit <- tryCatch({
      aucs <- sapply(existing_list, function(m) {
        if (!inherits(m, "train") || is.null(m$pred) || !"TP" %in% colnames(m$pred)) return(NA_real_)
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(response = m$pred$obs, predictor = m$pred$TP, levels = c("FP", "TP"), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)))
      })
      valid_m <- names(sort(aucs[!is.na(aucs)], decreasing = TRUE))
      if (length(valid_m) >= 2) {
        top2_mods <- existing_list[valid_m[1:2]]
        class(top2_mods) <- c("caretList", "list")
        set.seed(1234)
        caretEnsemble::caretStack(
          top2_mods,
          method = "glm",
          metric = "ROC",
          trControl = caret::trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, savePredictions = "final", classProbs = TRUE, summaryFunction = caret::twoClassSummary)
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(stack_fit)) {
      existing_list[["Ensamble_Stacking"]] <- stack_fit
    }
  }

  ordered_keys <- intersect(c(names(specs), "Ensamble_Stacking"), names(existing_list))
  existing_list <- existing_list[ordered_keys]

  if (!is.null(target_rds_path) && dir.exists(dirname(target_rds_path))) {
    tryCatch(saveRDS(existing_list, target_rds_path), error = function(e) {})
  }
  return(existing_list)
}

# 2. Localizar o preparar los datasets de validacion inter-especie (S. citrullifolium y S. stellatiglandulosum)
find_first_existing <- function(candidates) {
  candidates <- candidates[!is.na(candidates) & nzchar(candidates)]
  for (cand in candidates) {
    exp_cand <- path.expand(cand)
    if (file.exists(exp_cand)) return(normalizePath(exp_cand, mustWork = FALSE))
  }
  NULL
}

  file.path(ref_base_candidates, "Genes_Capture_May_2026.xlsx")

  params$captus_stats,
  file.path(proj_root, "data", "reference", "captus-extract_stats.tsv"),
  file.path(proj_root, "data", "CAPTUS_Muestras", "captus-extract_stats.tsv"),
  path.expand("~/Documentos/Formacion/Maestria/Tesis/Archivos_Referencia/Captus_Local/03_extract_metabolismo/captus-extract_stats.tsv")
))

load_or_prepare_species <- function(rds_param,
                                    sample_id,
                                    genome_scale = c("chromosome", "contig"),
                                    gff_ref_candidates = character(0),
                                    captus_gff_candidates = character(0),
                                    default_save_rds = NULL) {
  genome_scale <- match.arg(genome_scale)
  existing_data <- find_first_existing(c(rds_param, sub("\\.rds$", ".tsv", rds_param)))
  if (!is.null(existing_data)) {
    df_sp <- if (grepl("\\.rds$", existing_data, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      readRDS(existing_data)
    } else {
      utils::read.delim(existing_data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    if (is.null(attr(df_sp, "genome_scale"))) attr(df_sp, "genome_scale") <- genome_scale
    if (is.null(attr(df_sp, "target_mode")))  attr(df_sp, "target_mode")  <- if (genome_scale == "chromosome") "overlap" else "target_attr"
    attr(df_sp, "origin_file") <- basename(existing_data)
    return(df_sp)
  }

  captus_gff_path <- find_first_existing(captus_gff_candidates)
  gff_ref_path    <- if (genome_scale == "chromosome") find_first_existing(gff_ref_candidates) else NULL

  if (!is.null(captus_gff_path) && !is.null(stats_file_resolved) && !is.null(dict_file_resolved) &&
      (genome_scale == "contig" || !is.null(gff_ref_path))) {
    df_sp <- tryCatch({
      prepare_transfer_species_data(
        sample_name  = sample_id,
        genome_scale = genome_scale,
        captus_gff   = captus_gff_path,
        captus_stats = stats_file_resolved,
        dict_ref     = dict_file_resolved,
        gff_ref      = gff_ref_path,
        save_rds     = default_save_rds
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(df_sp)) {
      orig_parts <- basename(na.omit(c(gff_ref_path, captus_gff_path, stats_file_resolved, dict_file_resolved)))
      attr(df_sp, "origin_file") <- paste(orig_parts, collapse = ", ")
    }
    return(df_sp)
  }
  NULL
}

# Lector opcional de archivo externo de fuentes y citas bibliograficas (params$sources_file)
load_sources_citations <- function(sources_param, proj_root = ".") {
  if (is.null(sources_param) || !nzchar(trimws(sources_param))) return(NULL)
  cand <- c(
    sources_param,
    file.path(proj_root, sources_param),
    file.path(proj_root, "data", "reference", "sources_citations.tsv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "sources_citations.tsv")
  )
  found <- cand[file.exists(cand)][1]
  if (is.na(found) || !nzchar(found)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(
    utils::read.delim(found, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

lookup_source_entry <- function(sources_df, sample_id = NULL, genome_scale = NULL) {
  if (is.null(sources_df) || nrow(sources_df) == 0 || !"sample_id" %in% colnames(sources_df)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(sample_id) && nzchar(sample_id)) {
    hit <- sources_df[tolower(trimws(sources_df$sample_id)) == tolower(trimws(sample_id)), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(hit) > 0) return(hit[1, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  if (!is.null(genome_scale) && nzchar(genome_scale)) {
    def_key <- if (tolower(genome_scale) == "contig") "contig_default" else "chromosome_default"
    hit <- sources_df[tolower(trimws(sources_df$sample_id)) == def_key, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(hit) > 0) return(hit[1, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  NULL
}

          data          = df_ex
        )
      }

# 3. Funcion que evalua TODOS los modelos entrenados en S. torvum (Balanceados y Desbalanceados) sobre una especie receptora
evaluate_transfer_on_species <- function(df_sp, models_list, scenario_key = "balanced") {
  pred_cols <- intersect(c("pct_recovered", "pct_identity", "score", "wscore"), colnames(df_sp))
  df_clean <- df_sp %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Validacion_Espacial)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Clase_Real = factor(ifelse(Validacion_Espacial %in% c("TRUE_POSITIVE", "TP"), "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP")),
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(pred_cols), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(pred_cols)))) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  x_new <- df_clean[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]
  y_obs <- df_clean$Clase_Real

  rows   <- list()
  cms    <- list()
  scores <- list()
  preds  <- list()

  # A. Cortes Univariados de Youden aprendidos en S. torvum
  if (!is.null(youden_thresholds)) {
    for (y_var in names(youden_thresholds)) {
      if (y_var %in% colnames(x_new)) {
        m_label <- paste0("Youden_", y_var)
        thr_val <- as.numeric(youden_thresholds[[y_var]])
        pred_y  <- factor(ifelse(x_new[[y_var]] >= thr_val, "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP"))
        rows[[m_label]] <- compute_classification_metrics(
          pred = pred_y, obs = y_obs, score = x_new[[y_var]], positive_class = "TP", model_name = m_label
        )
        cms[[m_label]]    <- table(Prediccion = pred_y, Referencia = y_obs)
        scores[[m_label]] <- as.numeric(x_new[[y_var]])
        preds[[m_label]]  <- pred_y
      }
    }
  }

  # B. Modelo Heuristico Ponderado aprendido en S. torvum
  if (!is.null(heuristic_model) && !is.null(youden_thresholds)) {
    m_names  <- names(heuristic_model$weights)
    v_mat    <- sapply(m_names, function(m) as.numeric(x_new[[m]] >= youden_thresholds[[m]]))
    scores_h <- as.vector(v_mat %*% heuristic_model$weights)
    pred_h   <- factor(ifelse(scores_h >= heuristic_model$global_threshold, "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP"))
    rows[["Weighted_Heuristic"]] <- compute_classification_metrics(
      pred = pred_h, obs = y_obs, score = scores_h, positive_class = "TP", model_name = "Weighted_Heuristic"
    )
    cms[["Weighted_Heuristic"]]    <- table(Prediccion = pred_h, Referencia = y_obs)
    scores[["Weighted_Heuristic"]] <- scores_h
    preds[["Weighted_Heuristic"]]  <- pred_h
  }

  # C. Todos los modelos supervisados de Machine Learning + Ensamble_Stacking entrenados en S. torvum
  if (!is.null(models_list) && length(models_list) > 0) {
    for (m_name in names(models_list)) {
      mod_obj <- models_list[[m_name]]
      if (inherits(mod_obj, "caretStack")) {
        tryCatch({
          base_mods <- mod_obj$models
          prob_base <- as.data.frame(lapply(base_mods, function(bm) stats::predict(bm, newdata = x_new, type = "prob")[["TP"]]))
          colnames(prob_base) <- names(base_mods)
          probs_s <- stats::predict(mod_obj$ens_model, newdata = prob_base, type = "prob")[["TP"]]
          preds_s <- factor(ifelse(probs_s > 0.5, "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP"))
          rows[[m_name]] <- compute_classification_metrics(
            pred = preds_s, obs = y_obs, score = probs_s, positive_class = "TP", model_name = m_name
          )
          cms[[m_name]]    <- table(Prediccion = preds_s, Referencia = y_obs)
          scores[[m_name]] <- probs_s
          preds[[m_name]]  <- preds_s
        }, error = function(e) {})
      } else {
        tryCatch({
          pred_c <- stats::predict(mod_obj, newdata = x_new)
          pred_c <- factor(ifelse(as.character(pred_c) %in% c("TP", "TRUE_POSITIVE"), "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP"))
          prob_c <- tryCatch(stats::predict(mod_obj, newdata = x_new, type = "prob")[["TP"]], error = function(e) NULL)
          rows[[m_name]] <- compute_classification_metrics(
            pred = pred_c, obs = y_obs, score = prob_c, positive_class = "TP", model_name = m_name
          )
          cms[[m_name]]    <- table(Prediccion = pred_c, Referencia = y_obs)
          scores[[m_name]] <- prob_c
          preds[[m_name]]  <- pred_c
        }, error = function(e) {})
      }
    }
  }

  # D. Consenso de 7 Modelos (4 ML + 2 Youden + 1 Heuristico, umbral >= 4/7)
  voter_candidates <- c("ElasticNet", "NaiveBayes", "SVM_Polinomial", "Red_Neuronal",
                        "Youden_pct_recovered", "Youden_pct_identity", "Weighted_Heuristic")
  avail_voters <- intersect(voter_candidates, names(preds))
  if (length(avail_voters) >= 5) {
    votes_mat <- sapply(avail_voters, function(vn) as.integer(preds[[vn]] == "TP"))
    votes_sum <- rowSums(votes_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    pred_cons <- factor(ifelse(votes_sum >= 4, "TP", "FP"), levels = c("TP", "FP"))
    rows[["Consenso_7_Modelos"]] <- compute_classification_metrics(
      pred = pred_cons, obs = y_obs, score = votes_sum / length(avail_voters), positive_class = "TP", model_name = "Consenso_7_Modelos"
    )
    cms[["Consenso_7_Modelos"]]    <- table(Prediccion = pred_cons, Referencia = y_obs)
    scores[["Consenso_7_Modelos"]] <- votes_sum
    preds[["Consenso_7_Modelos"]]  <- pred_cons
  }

  df_bench <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Modelo) & nzchar(as.character(Modelo))) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Modelo, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score))

  cms <- cms[intersect(df_bench$Modelo, names(cms))]

  list(
    df_clean  = df_clean,
    benchmark = df_bench,
    cms       = cms,
    scores    = scores,
    preds     = preds
  )
}

# Evaluar todas las especies registradas en ambos escenarios de entrenamiento (Balanceado y Desbalanceados)
transfer_results <- list()
all_species_bench_list <- list()

for (sp_key in names(species_registry)) {
  sp_info    <- species_registry[[sp_key]]
  eval_bal   <- evaluate_transfer_on_species(sp_info$data, models_bal,   "balanced")
  eval_unbal <- evaluate_transfer_on_species(sp_info$data, models_unbal, "unbalanced")

  transfer_results[[sp_key]] <- list(
    info  = sp_info,
    bal   = eval_bal,
    unbal = eval_unbal
  )

  out_sp_tsv <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("transferability_%s.tsv", tolower(sp_key)))
  tryCatch(
    utils::write.table(eval_bal$benchmark, file = out_sp_tsv, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {}
  )

  all_species_bench_list[[sp_key]] <- eval_bal$benchmark %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Especie = sp_info$short_name,
      Escala_Genoma = if (sp_info$genome_scale == "chromosome") "Escala Cromosómica" else "Escala de Contigs",
      .before = 1
    )
}

      .before = 1
    )
}

df_multiespecie_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_species_bench_list)
if (nrow(df_multiespecie_all) > 0) {

    error = function(e) {}

}

# Funciones de renderizado de grillas de matrices de confusion para cada especie
render_species_cms_grid <- function(sp_key, mode = c("top6", "thesis9", "top3_f1")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  res_sp   <- transfer_results[[sp_key]]
  bench_df <- res_sp$bal$benchmark
  all_cms  <- res_sp$bal$cms
  sp_name  <- res_sp$info$short_name
  sc_label <- if (res_sp$info$genome_scale == "chromosome") "Escala Cromosómica" else "Escala de Contigs"

  if (is.null(bench_df) || length(all_cms) == 0) {
    cat("> *No hay matrices de confusión disponibles para esta especie.*\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (mode == "top6") {
    selected_mods <- intersect(get_top6_summary_models(bench_df), names(all_cms))
    n_cols <- 2
    banner_txt <- sprintf("Resumen de Matrices Clave en %s (%s): Top 2 Youden + Heurístico + Top 3 ML", sp_name, sc_label)
  } else if (mode == "thesis9") {
    canonical_9 <- c("Youden_pct_recovered", "Youden_pct_identity", "Weighted_Heuristic",
                     "ElasticNet", "NaiveBayes", "SVM_Polinomial", "MLP", "LDA", "Ensamble_Stacking")
    selected_mods <- intersect(canonical_9, names(all_cms))
    n_cols <- 3
    banner_txt <- sprintf("Transferencia en %s (%s): 9 Modelos Estandarizados (Cortes Empíricos vs. ML vs. Stacking)", sp_name, sc_label)
  } else {
    ml_only <- bench_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!grepl("^Youden_", Modelo) & !Modelo %in% c("Weighted_Heuristic", "Ensamble_Stacking", "Consenso_7_Modelos")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(F1_Score), dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC)) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Modelo)
    selected_mods <- intersect(ml_only, names(all_cms))
    n_cols <- 3
    banner_txt <- sprintf("Top 3 Algoritmos Supervisados Específicos para %s (%s — Ordenados por F1-Score)", sp_name, sc_label)
  }

  plot_list <- lapply(selected_mods, function(m_name) {
    tab_m <- all_cms[[m_name]]
    pal   <- get_model_color_palette(m_name)
    acc_m <- sum(diag(tab_m)) / sum(tab_m)
    row_i <- bench_df %>% dplyr::filter(Modelo == m_name)
    sub_txt <- if (nrow(row_i) > 0) {
      sprintf("F1: %.3f | Acc: %.1f%% | Sens: %.1f%% | FDR: %.1f%%",
              row_i$F1_Score[1], acc_m * 100, row_i$Sensibilidad[1] * 100, row_i$FDR[1] * 100)
    } else {
      sprintf("Exactitud: %.1f%%", acc_m * 100)
    }
    plot_confusion_matrix(
      tab_m,
      title = m_name,
      subtitle = sub_txt,
      high_color = pal$high,
      low_color = pal$low
    )
  })

  title_banner <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_label(banner_txt, fontface = "bold", size = 13, color = "#2c3e50")
  grid_body <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = n_cols, align = "hv")
  print(cowplot::plot_grid(title_banner, grid_body, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1)))
}

# Constructor del grafico Raincloud segmentado en 3 partes (Densidad superior + Boxplot central + Rainplot inferior)
# inspirado en el codigo de referencia (colorspace + ggplot2), manteniendo el titulo y subtitulo originales
plot_transfer_raincloud <- function(df_sc, mod_name, sp_name) {
  # Niveles: FP abajo (x = 1) y TP arriba (x = 2) al aplicar coord_flip()
  df_sc <- df_sc %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Puntaje) & !is.na(Clase_Real)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Clase_Factor = factor(as.character(Clase_Real), levels = c("FP", "TP")),
      x_num = as.numeric(Clase_Factor)
    )

  if (nrow(df_sc) < 2) return(NULL)

  pal_base <- c("FP" = "#c0392b", "TP" = "#27ae60")
  has_cs   <- requireNamespace("colorspace", quietly = TRUE)

  col_dark <- if (has_cs) {
    stats::setNames(colorspace::darken(pal_base, 0.12, space = "HLS"), names(pal_base))
  } else {
    c("FP" = "#922b21", "TP" = "#1e8449")
  }
  col_fill_dens <- if (has_cs) {
    stats::setNames(colorspace::lighten(pal_base, 0.48), names(pal_base))
  } else {
    stats::setNames(grDevices::adjustcolor(pal_base, alpha.f = 0.55), names(pal_base))
  }
  col_fill_box <- if (has_cs) {
    stats::setNames(colorspace::desaturate(colorspace::lighten(pal_base, 0.80), 0.40), names(pal_base))
  } else {
    stats::setNames(grDevices::adjustcolor(pal_base, alpha.f = 0.22), names(pal_base))
  }

  y_min  <- min(df_sc$Puntaje, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max  <- max(df_sc$Puntaje, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_span <- if ((y_max - y_min) > 1e-6) (y_max - y_min) else 1.0

  # 1. Parte 1 (Arriba de cada grupo): Poligono de media densidad (half-eye / cloud)
  dens_list <- lapply(c("FP", "TP"), function(cl) {
    sub_v <- df_sc$Puntaje[df_sc$Clase_Factor == cl]
    if (length(sub_v) == 0) return(NULL)
    x_b <- if (cl == "FP") 1.0 else 2.0
    bw_val <- if (length(sub_v) > 1 && stats::sd(sub_v) > 1e-6) {
      max(stats::bw.nrd0(sub_v) * 0.65, 0.025 * y_span)
    } else {
      0.04 * y_span
    }
    d_obj <- stats::density(
      sub_v,
      bw = bw_val,
      n = 128,
      from = y_min - 0.02 * y_span,
      to   = y_max + 0.02 * y_span
    )
    d_norm <- if (max(d_obj$y) > 0) (d_obj$y / max(d_obj$y)) * 0.36 else rep(0, length(d_obj$y))
    # La nube de densidad se ubica en la franja superior [x_b + 0.15, x_b + 0.51]
    data.frame(
      Clase_Factor = factor(cl, levels = c("FP", "TP")),
      x_poly = c(rep(x_b + 0.15, length(d_obj$x)), rev(x_b + 0.15 + d_norm)),
      y_poly = c(d_obj$x, rev(d_obj$x))
    )
  })
  df_dens <- dplyr::bind_rows(dens_list)

  # 2. Parte 2 (Centro de cada grupo): Estadisticos de mediana y conteo n para el boxplot central (en x_b)
  df_stats <- df_sc %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Clase_Factor, x_num) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mediana = stats::median(Puntaje, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_obs   = dplyr::n(),
      max_y   = max(Puntaje, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      med_label = sprintf("%.2f", mediana),
      n_label   = paste("n =", n_obs),
      y_n_pos   = y_max + 0.045 * y_span
    )

  # 3. Parte 3 (Debajo de cada grupo): Puntos individuales con jitter (rainplot en [x_b - 0.35, x_b - 0.14])
  set.seed(1)
  df_sc$x_rain <- df_sc$x_num - stats::runif(nrow(df_sc), min = 0.14, max = 0.34)

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    # Parte 1: Grafico de densidad (Half-eye superior)
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = df_dens,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_poly, y = y_poly, group = Clase_Factor, fill = Clase_Factor, color = Clase_Factor),
      linewidth = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    # Parte 2: Boxplot central
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      data = df_sc,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_num, y = Puntaje, group = Clase_Factor, color = Clase_Factor),
      fill = col_fill_box[as.character(levels(df_sc$Clase_Factor))[sort(unique(df_sc$x_num))]],
      width = 0.20,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    # Parte 3: Rainplot (doble capa de puntos estilo Scherer: fondo blanco con borde + relleno semitransparente)
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = df_sc,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_rain, y = Puntaje, color = Clase_Factor),
      fill = "white",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.42,
      size = 2.0
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = df_sc,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_rain, y = Puntaje, fill = Clase_Factor),
      color = "transparent",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.42,
      size = 2.0,
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    # Etiqueta de la mediana sobre el boxplot
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = df_stats,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_num + 0.17, y = mediana, label = med_label, color = Clase_Factor),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.6,
      vjust = -0.3
    ) +
    # Etiqueta del tamaño muestral (n = ...)
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = df_stats,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_num, y = y_n_pos, label = n_label, color = Clase_Factor),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.5,
      hjust = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip(
      xlim = c(0.52, 2.62),
      ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_span, y_max + 0.20 * y_span),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("FP", "TP")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = col_dark, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = col_fill_dens, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Separación de Puntaje/Probabilidad: ", mod_name),
      subtitle = paste0("Distribución en ", sp_name, " (TP vs. FP)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Probabilidad P(TP) / Puntaje"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = col_dark[c("FP", "TP")],
        face = "bold",
        size = 13
      ),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 10.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8)
      ),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        color = "#5d6d7e",
        size = 9.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 10, 0)
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 18, 10, 12)
    )
}

# Renderiza el diagnostico individual de un modelo transferido sobre una especie (Matriz + Raincloud Plot segmentado)
render_single_transfer_model <- function(sp_key, mod_name) {
  res_sp   <- transfer_results[[sp_key]]
  bench_df <- res_sp$bal$benchmark
  all_cms  <- res_sp$bal$cms
  scores_l <- res_sp$bal$scores
  df_clean <- res_sp$bal$df_clean
  sp_name  <- res_sp$info$short_name
  pal      <- get_model_color_palette(mod_name)

  row_m <- bench_df %>% dplyr::filter(Modelo == mod_name)
  if (nrow(row_m) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "<div class='model-badge' style='background-color:%s;'>%s en %s — F1: %.3f | ROC-AUC: %.3f | Exactitud: %.2f%% | Exactitud Bal.: %.2f%% | Sensibilidad: %.2f%% | Especificidad: %.2f%% | Precisión: %.2f%% | FDR: %.2f%%</div>\n\n",
      pal$high, mod_name, sp_name,
      row_m$F1_Score[1], row_m$ROC_AUC[1],
      row_m$Exactitud[1] * 100,
      row_m$Exactitud_Balanceada[1] * 100,
      row_m$Sensibilidad[1] * 100,
      row_m$Especificidad[1] * 100,
      row_m$Precision[1] * 100,
      row_m$FDR[1] * 100
    ))
  }

  tab_cm <- all_cms[[mod_name]]
  p_cm <- if (!is.null(tab_cm)) {
    acc_val <- sum(diag(tab_cm)) / sum(tab_cm)
    plot_confusion_matrix(
      tab_cm,
      title = paste0("Matriz de Confusión: ", mod_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("%s (Exactitud: %.2f%%)", sp_name, acc_val * 100),
      high_color = pal$high,
      low_color = pal$low
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  p_dist <- NULL
  sc_vec <- scores_l[[mod_name]]
  if (!is.null(sc_vec) && length(sc_vec) == nrow(df_clean)) {
    df_sc <- data.frame(
      Clase_Real = df_clean$Clase_Real,
      Puntaje = as.numeric(sc_vec)
    ) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Puntaje))

    if (nrow(df_sc) > 2) {
      p_dist <- plot_transfer_raincloud(df_sc, mod_name = mod_name, sp_name = sp_name)
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cm) && !is.null(p_dist)) {
    print(cowplot::plot_grid(p_cm, p_dist, ncol = 2, align = "h", rel_widths = c(0.95, 1.05)))
  } else if (!is.null(p_cm)) {
    print(p_cm)
  }
}

# Generador dinamico de pestañas de modelos dentro de cada especie
build_species_model_tabs_markdown <- function(sp_key) {
  res_sp   <- transfer_results[[sp_key]]
  bench_df <- res_sp$bal$benchmark
  all_cms  <- res_sp$bal$cms

  ordered_models <- intersect(bench_df$Modelo, names(all_cms))
  ordered_models <- c(ordered_models, setdiff(names(all_cms), ordered_models))

  bt3 <- strrep("`", 3)
  child_chunks <- character()

  # Pestaña 1: Resumen Top 6 (2 Youden + Heuristico + 3 ML)
  child_chunks <- c(child_chunks, sprintf(
    "##### Resumen: Top 6 (2 Youden + Heurístico + 3 ML)\n\n%s{r top6_%s, fig.width=10, fig.height=10.2, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\nrender_species_cms_grid('%s', 'top6')\n%s\n",
    bt3, sp_key, sp_key, bt3
  ))

  # Pestaña 2: Resumen 9 Modelos Estandarizados de la Tesis (3x3)
  child_chunks <- c(child_chunks, sprintf(
    "##### Resumen Tesis: 9 Modelos Estándar (3x3)\n\n%s{r thesis9_%s, fig.width=11, fig.height=10.5, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\nrender_species_cms_grid('%s', 'thesis9')\n%s\n",
    bt3, sp_key, sp_key, bt3
  ))

  # Pestaña 3: Top 3 Algoritmos ML Especificos (por F1-Score)
  child_chunks <- c(child_chunks, sprintf(
    "##### Top 3 ML Específicos (F1-Score)\n\n%s{r top3f1_%s, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=4.3, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\nrender_species_cms_grid('%s', 'top3_f1')\n%s\n",
    bt3, sp_key, sp_key, bt3
  ))

  # Pestañas individuales por modelo
  for (idx in seq_along(ordered_models)) {
    m_name  <- ordered_models[idx]
    safe_id <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", paste0(sp_key, "_", m_name, "_", idx))
    child_chunks <- c(child_chunks, sprintf(
      "##### %s\n\n%s{r mod_%s, fig.width=10.2, fig.height=4.7, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\nrender_single_transfer_model('%s', '%s')\n%s\n",
      m_name, bt3, safe_id, sp_key, m_name, bt3
    ))
  }

  res_md <- knitr::knit_child(
    text = paste(child_chunks, collapse = "\n\n"),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  cat(res_md, sep = "\n")
}
```

## Arquitectura de Validación Filogenética según Calidad del Genoma

Este reporte evalúa la capacidad de generalización inter-especie (**transferencia filogenética**) de los modelos entrenados exclusivamente sobre ***Solanum torvum*** cuando se aplican sin reentrenamiento sobre especies con distinta distancia evolutiva y **distinto grado de calidad de ensamblaje genómico**, clasificando cada secuencia funcional de CAPTUS (`marker_type == NUC`) en dos categorías binarias: **TP (`TRUE_POSITIVE`, homólogo válido)** y **FP (`FALSE_POSITIVE`, falso positivo)**:

```{r arch_sources_overview, results="asis"}
src_chr <- lookup_source_entry(sources_df, sample_id = "Scitrullifolium", genome_scale = "chromosome")
src_ctg <- lookup_source_entry(sources_df, sample_id = "S_stella",        genome_scale = "contig")

orig_chr_files <- paste(sapply(Filter(function(x) x$genome_scale == "chromosome", species_registry), function(x) x$origin_file), collapse = ", ")
if (!nzchar(orig_chr_files)) orig_chr_files <- basename(params$cit_data)

orig_ctg_files <- paste(sapply(Filter(function(x) x$genome_scale == "contig", species_registry), function(x) x$origin_file), collapse = ", ")
if (!nzchar(orig_ctg_files)) orig_ctg_files <- basename(params$ste_data)

cat("1. <span class=\"scale-badge chr\">Escala Cromosómica (`--genome_scale chromosome`)</span> **Genomas ensamblados a nivel de cromosomas o pseudomoléculas:**\n")
if (!is.null(src_chr)) {
  cat(sprintf("   - **Fuente del Genoma de Referencia:** %s\n", as.character(src_chr$genome_source[1])))
  cat(sprintf("   - **Fuente del Catálogo de Genes Homólogos (`OG_ID`):** %s\n", as.character(src_chr$homology_source[1])))
}
cat(sprintf("   - **Archivo de Origen:** `%s`\n", orig_chr_files))
cat("   - **Procesamiento Algorítmico (`--target_mode overlap`):** Armoniza los nombres de cromosomas/scaffolds (`seqlevels`), ejecuta **intersección espacial física estricta** (`GenomicRanges::findOverlaps`, `ignore.strand = FALSE`) entre los cóntigos funcionales de CAPTUS (`protein_match:NUC`) y los genes anotados en el archivo GFF3 cromosómico de referencia (`type == \"gene\"`), y asigna la etiqueta binaria **TP** (homólogo válido único del locus) o **FP**.\n\n")

cat("2. <span class=\"scale-badge ctg\">Escala de Contigs (`--genome_scale contig`)</span> **Genomas fragmentados a nivel de cóntigos *de novo*:**\n")
if (!is.null(src_ctg)) {
  cat(sprintf("   - **Fuente del Genoma de Referencia:** %s\n", as.character(src_ctg$genome_source[1])))
  cat(sprintf("   - **Fuentes del Catálogo de Genes Homólogos (`HOG_ID`) y Tabla Puente (`OG_ID <-> HOG_ID`):** %s\n", as.character(src_ctg$homology_source[1])))
}
cat(sprintf("   - **Archivo de Origen:** `%s`\n", orig_ctg_files))
cat("   - **Procesamiento Algorítmico (`--target_mode target_attr`):** Dado que el ensamblaje se encuentra a escala de cóntigos sin un GFF3 cromosómico independiente, extrae el identificador del gen de referencia (`<transcript_id>-<OG_ID>`) directamente desde el atributo **`Target`** de cada registro `protein_match:NUC` en el GFF de CAPTUS, colapsa los múltiples exones de un mismo hit con `distinct()`, traduce `OG_Captus` a `HOG_ID` mediante la tabla puente `OG_ID <-> HOG_ID` y asigna la etiqueta binaria **TP** (homólogo válido único confirmado por `HOG_ID == OG_Ste`) o **FP**.\n")
```

```{r global_kpi_summary, results='asis'}
      cls_col, res_sp$info$short_name, sc_tag, n_tot, n_tp, n_fp,
      best_r$Modelo[1], best_r$F1_Score[1], best_r$ROC_AUC[1]
```

<details>
<summary class="summary-btn">📐 Mostrar / Ocultar Fórmulas de las Métricas de Evaluación</summary>
<div class="formula-box">

Sea $TP$ (Verdaderos Positivos), $FP$ (Falsos Positivos), $TN$ (Verdaderos Negativos) y $FN$ (Falsos Negativos):

1. **Exactitud (*Accuracy*):** $\text{Exactitud} = \frac{TP + TN}{TP + FP + FN + TN}$
2. **Sensibilidad (*Recall / TPR*):** $\text{Sensibilidad} = \frac{TP}{TP + FN}$
3. **Especificidad (*TNR*):** $\text{Especificidad} = \frac{TN}{TN + FP}$
4. **Exactitud Balanceada (*Balanced Accuracy*):** $\text{Exactitud Balanceada} = \frac{\text{Sensibilidad} + \text{Especificidad}}{2}$
5. **Precisión (*PPV*):** $\text{Precisión} = \frac{TP}{TP + FP}$
6. **Tasa de Falsos Descubrimientos (*FDR*):** $\text{FDR} = 1 - \text{Precisión} = \frac{FP}{TP + FP}$
7. **F1-Score:** $\text{F1-Score} = 2 \times \frac{\text{Precisión} \times \text{Sensibilidad}}{\text{Precisión} + \text{Sensibilidad}}$
8. **ROC-AUC:** Área bajo la curva ROC en todos los puntos de corte posibles.
9. **MCC (*Coeficiente de Correlación de Matthews*):** $\text{MCC} = \frac{(TP \times TN) - (FP \times FN)}{\sqrt{(TP + FP)(TP + FN)(TN + FP)(TN + FN)}}$

</div>
</details>

## Validación por Especie y Tipo de Genoma (Pestañas Multiespecie)

Selecciona la pestaña de cada especie validada para inspeccionar su procesamiento algorítmico según el tipo de genoma (**Escala Cromosómica** vs. **Escala de Contigs**), el resumen de secuencias evaluadas (`TP` vs. `FP`), el benchmark interactivo, las tablas exportables con indicador **`*`** de comparación entre versiones (*Balanceado* vs. *Desbalanceado*) y las matrices de confusión acompañadas de su gráfico combinado de densidad, boxplot y rainplot:

```{r render_multispecies_tabset, results='asis'}
if (length(transfer_results) == 0) {
  cat("> **Aviso:** No se encontraron los archivos preparados ni los archivos crudos de *S. citrullifolium* o *S. stellatiglandulosum*. Ejecute `./targetcnv.sh transfer` o prepare las especies con `01_prepare_data.R`.\n")
} else {
  bt3 <- strrep("`", 3)
  sp_tabs_md <- c("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")

  for (sp_key in names(transfer_results)) {
    res_sp   <- transfer_results[[sp_key]]
    sp_info  <- res_sp$info
    is_chr   <- (sp_info$genome_scale == "chromosome")
    sc_short <- if (is_chr) "Escala Cromosómica" else "Escala de Contigs"
    box_cls  <- if (is_chr) "genome-arch-box" else "genome-arch-box contig"
    badge_cl <- if (is_chr) "chr" else "ctg"

    df_c <- res_sp$bal$df_clean
    n_tot <- nrow(df_c)
    n_tp  <- sum(df_c$Clase_Real == "TP", na.rm = TRUE)
    n_fp  <- sum(df_c$Clase_Real == "FP", na.rm = TRUE)
    pct_tp <- round((n_tp / max(1, n_tot)) * 100, 1)
    pct_fp <- round((n_fp / max(1, n_tot)) * 100, 1)

    n_ogs_cap <- attr(sp_info$data, "n_ogs_captus")
    n_ogs_brg <- attr(sp_info$data, "n_ogs_bridge")
    bridge_txt <- if (!is_chr && !is.null(n_ogs_cap) && !is.na(n_ogs_cap)) {
      sprintf(" | Cobertura del Puente OG↔HOG: <b>%d de %d OGs</b> de CAPTUS", n_ogs_brg, n_ogs_cap)
    } else {
      ""
    }

    src_lines_html <- if (isTRUE(sp_info$has_citation)) {
      paste0(
        sprintf('<b>• Fuente del Genoma de Referencia:</b> %s<br>\n', sp_info$genome_source),
        sprintf('<b>• Fuente de Homología y Datos Génicos:</b> %s%s<br>\n', sp_info$db_info, bridge_txt),
        sprintf('<b>• Archivo de Origen:</b> <code>%s</code><br>\n', sp_info$origin_file)
      )
    } else {
      sprintf('<b>• Archivo de Origen:</b> <code>%s</code>%s<br>\n', sp_info$origin_file, bridge_txt)
    }

    header_block <- paste0(
      sprintf("# *%s* (%s)\n\n", sp_info$short_name, sc_short),
      sprintf('<div class="%s">\n', box_cls),
      sprintf('<span class="scale-badge %s">%s</span> <b>Especie Validada:</b> <i>%s</i> (Muestra: <code>%s</code>)<br>\n',
              badge_cl, sc_short, sp_info$sci_name, sp_info$id),
      src_lines_html,
      sprintf('<b>• Algoritmo de Cruce Espacial:</b> %s\n', sp_info$algo_info),
      '</div>\n\n',
      '<div class="kpi-grid">',
      sprintf('<div class="kpi-card"><div class="kpi-title">Secuencias NUC Evaluadas</div><div class="kpi-value">%d</div><div class="kpi-sub">Muestra %s</div></div>', n_tot, sp_info$id),
      sprintf('<div class="kpi-card green"><div class="kpi-title">Verdaderos Positivos (TP)</div><div class="kpi-value">%d (%s%%)</div><div class="kpi-sub">Homólogos válidos</div></div>', n_tp, pct_tp),
      sprintf('<div class="kpi-card red"><div class="kpi-title">Falsos Positivos (FP)</div><div class="kpi-value">%d (%s%%)</div><div class="kpi-sub">Secuencias no válidas (FP)</div></div>', n_fp, pct_fp),
      sprintf('<div class="kpi-card purple"><div class="kpi-title">Tipo de Genoma</div><div class="kpi-value">%s</div><div class="kpi-sub">Modo: %s</div></div>',
              sc_short, if (is_chr) "overlap (GenomicRanges)" else "target_attr + Puente HOG↔OG"),
      '</div>\n\n'
    )

    chunk_gt <- paste0(
      sprintf("### Resumen de Secuencias de Validación (TP vs. FP) en *%s*\n\n", sp_info$short_name),
      sprintf(
        "%s{r gt_summary_%s, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n",
        bt3, sp_key
      ),
      sprintf("df_sp_curr <- transfer_results[['%s']]$bal$df_clean\n", sp_key),
      "df_res_cl <- df_sp_curr %>%\n",
      "  dplyr::mutate(Clase = ifelse(Clase_Real == 'TP', 'TP (Verdadero Positivo)', 'FP (Falso Positivo)')) %>%\n",
      "  dplyr::group_by(Clase) %>%\n",
      "  dplyr::summarise(\n",
      "    Secuencias = dplyr::n(),\n",
      "    Porcentaje = round((dplyr::n() / nrow(df_sp_curr)) * 100, 2),\n",
      "    `Media % Recuperado` = round(mean(as.numeric(pct_recovered), na.rm = TRUE), 2),\n",
      "    `Media % Identidad`  = round(mean(as.numeric(pct_identity), na.rm = TRUE), 2),\n",
      "    `Media Score`        = round(mean(as.numeric(score), na.rm = TRUE), 2),\n",
      "    `Media WScore`       = round(mean(as.numeric(wscore), na.rm = TRUE), 2),\n",
      "    .groups = 'drop'\n",
      "  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Clase))\n",
      "DT::datatable(df_res_cl, rownames = FALSE,\n",
      sprintf("  caption = 'Resumen de secuencias evaluadas en %s (Total = %d secuencias NUC)',\n", sp_info$short_name, n_tot),
      "  options = list(dom = 't', ordering = FALSE, autoWidth = FALSE)) %>%\n",
      "  DT::formatCurrency(columns = 'Porcentaje', currency = '%', before = FALSE, digits = 2)\n",
      sprintf("%s\n\n", bt3)
    )

    chunk_bench <- paste0(
      sprintf("### Benchmark Multimétrica de Transferencia en *%s*\n\n", sp_info$short_name),
      "Por defecto se muestran los **6 modelos clave** (los **2 mejores cortes de Youden**, el **Modelo Heurístico** y los **3 mejores modelos de ML** excluyendo `Ensamble_Stacking`), ordenados de arriba a abajo del mejor al peor **ROC-AUC**. Usa los botones desplegables debajo del gráfico para ver los **9 modelos estandarizados de la tesis**, **todos los modelos evaluados** o desplegar la **tabla completa con comparación de escenarios (`*`)**:\n\n",
      sprintf("%s{r plot_top6_%s, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3, sp_key),
      sprintf("b_full <- transfer_results[['%s']]$bal$benchmark\n", sp_key),
      "t6 <- get_top6_summary_models(b_full)\n",
      "df_t6 <- b_full %>% dplyr::filter(Modelo %in% t6) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score))\n",
      sprintf("build_interactive_benchmark_plotly(df_t6, species_title = '%s (%s)', view_label = '6 Modelos Clave')\n", sp_info$short_name, sc_short),
      sprintf("%s\n\n", bt3),

      "<details ontoggle=\"if(this.open){setTimeout(function(){window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));}, 60);}\">\n",
      sprintf("<summary class=\"summary-btn\">📊 Ver Benchmark de los 9 Modelos Estandarizados de la Tesis (%s)</summary>\n\n", sp_info$short_name),
      sprintf("%s{r plot_thesis9_%s, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3, sp_key),
      sprintf("b_full <- transfer_results[['%s']]$bal$benchmark\n", sp_key),
      "t9 <- get_thesis_9_models(b_full)\n",
      "df_t9 <- b_full %>% dplyr::filter(Modelo %in% t9) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(ROC_AUC), dplyr::desc(F1_Score))\n",
      sprintf("build_interactive_benchmark_plotly(df_t9, species_title = '%s (%s)', view_label = '9 Modelos Estándar Tesis')\n", sp_info$short_name, sc_short),
      sprintf("%s\n\n</details>\n\n", bt3),

      "<details ontoggle=\"if(this.open){setTimeout(function(){window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));}, 60);}\">\n",
      sprintf("<summary class=\"summary-btn\">📊 Ver Benchmark de Todos los Modelos Evaluados (%s)</summary>\n\n", sp_info$short_name),
      sprintf("%s{r plot_all_%s, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3, sp_key),
      sprintf("b_full <- transfer_results[['%s']]$bal$benchmark\n", sp_key),
      sprintf("build_interactive_benchmark_plotly(b_full, species_title = '%s (%s)', view_label = paste0('Todos los ', nrow(b_full), ' Modelos Evaluados'))\n", sp_info$short_name, sc_short),
      sprintf("%s\n\n</details>\n\n", bt3),

      "<details ontoggle=\"if(this.open){setTimeout(function(){window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); if(window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable){jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({visible:true, api:true}).columns.adjust();}}, 60);}\">\n",
      "<summary class=\"summary-btn\">📋 Ver Tabla</summary>\n\n",
      "<div class=\"asterisk-note\">\n",
      "**Nota sobre el asterisco (`*`) en la tabla de transferencia:** Los modelos marcados con **`*`** en la columna `Modelo` (y detallados en `Mejor_Version_FDR`) logran un mejor desempeño global sobre esta especie cuando se transfieren desde su versión entrenada en el **Escenario Desbalanceado** de *S. torvum* en lugar del *Balanceado*, evaluado con fuerte ponderación en el control del $\\text{FDR}$:\n",
      "$$\\text{Índice Global}_{\\text{FDR}} = 0.45(1 - \\text{FDR}) + 0.20\\,\\text{F1} + 0.15\\,\\text{MCC} + 0.10\\,\\text{Exactitud Bal.} + 0.10\\,\\text{ROC-AUC}$$\n",
      "</div>\n\n",
      sprintf("%s{r table_full_%s, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3, sp_key),
      sprintf("b_bal_sp   <- transfer_results[['%s']]$bal$benchmark\n", sp_key),
      sprintf("b_unbal_sp <- transfer_results[['%s']]$unbal$benchmark\n", sp_key),
      sprintf("format_benchmark_dt(b_bal_sp, other_df = b_unbal_sp, current_scen = 'Balanceado', other_scen = 'Desbalanceado', caption_text = 'Transferencia en %s (%s) — Modelos entrenados en S. torvum (* indica mejor transferencia desde versión Desbalanceada)')\n", sp_info$short_name, sc_short),
      sprintf("%s\n\n</details>\n\n", bt3)
    )

    chunk_cms <- paste0(
      sprintf("### Matrices de Confusión y Diagnóstico por Modelo (*%s*)\n\n", sp_info$short_name),
      "Las tres primeras pestañas muestran el **Resumen Top 6 Clave**, la **Cuadrícula 3x3 de los 9 Modelos Estandarizados de la Tesis** y los **Top 3 Algoritmos ML según F1-Score**; las pestañas siguientes permiten consultar uno por uno todos los modelos transferidos junto con su gráfico segmentado de densidad, boxplot y rainplot:\n\n",
      "::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n",
      sprintf("%s{r tabs_cms_%s, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3, sp_key),
      sprintf("build_species_model_tabs_markdown('%s')\n", sp_key),
      sprintf("%s\n\n:::\n\n", bt3)
    )

    sp_tabs_md <- c(sp_tabs_md, header_block, chunk_gt, chunk_bench, chunk_cms)
  }

  # Pestaña Final: Comparativa Multiespecie y Filtro por Escala de Genoma (sin emojis en el titulo)
  comp_tab_md <- paste0(
    "# Comparativa Multiespecie y por Escala de Genoma\n\n",
    "### Contraste de Desempeño según Calidad del Genoma (*S. torvum* vs. Escala Cromosómica vs. Escala de Contigs)\n\n",
    "El siguiente gráfico interactivo compara el **F1-Score**, **ROC-AUC**, **Exactitud**, **Sensibilidad** y **FDR** de los modelos entre la especie donante (*S. torvum*) y las especies receptoras según la calidad de su genoma (**Escala Cromosómica** en *S. citrullifolium* vs. **Escala de Contigs** en *S. stellatiglandulosum*). Usa el menú desplegable superior para cambiar la métrica comparada:\n\n",
    sprintf("%s{r multispecies_comp_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3),
    "if (nrow(df_multiespecie_all) > 0) {\n",
    "  key_mods <- c('Youden_pct_recovered', 'Youden_pct_identity', 'Weighted_Heuristic',\n",
    "                'ElasticNet', 'NaiveBayes', 'SVM_Polinomial', 'MLP', 'Red_Neuronal', 'LDA', 'Ensamble_Stacking', 'Consenso_7_Modelos')\n",
    "  df_comp_sub <- df_multiespecie_all %>%\n",
    "    dplyr::filter(Modelo %in% key_mods) %>%\n",
    "    dplyr::mutate(Etiqueta_Especie = paste0(Especie, ' [', Escala_Genoma, ']'))\n",
    "  sp_groups <- unique(df_comp_sub$Etiqueta_Especie)\n",
    "  palette_sp <- c('#2c3e50', '#16a085', '#d35400', '#8e44ad', '#2980b9')\n",
    "  fig_comp <- plotly::plot_ly(height = 680)\n",
    "  metrics_comp <- c('F1_Score', 'ROC_AUC', 'Exactitud_Balanceada', 'Sensibilidad', 'Especificidad', 'FDR')\n",
    "  for (m_idx in seq_along(metrics_comp)) {\n",
    "    m_col <- metrics_comp[m_idx]\n",
    "    for (s_idx in seq_along(sp_groups)) {\n",
    "      sp_lbl <- sp_groups[s_idx]\n",
    "      sub_d <- df_comp_sub %>% dplyr::filter(Etiqueta_Especie == sp_lbl)\n",
    "      vals_m <- round(as.numeric(sub_d[[m_col]]), 3)\n",
    "      fig_comp <- fig_comp %>% plotly::add_trace(\n",
    "        y = sub_d$Modelo,\n",
    "        x = vals_m,\n",
    "        name = sp_lbl,\n",
    "        type = 'bar',\n",
    "        orientation = 'h',\n",
    "        visible = (m_idx == 1),\n",
    "        marker = list(color = palette_sp[((s_idx - 1) %% length(palette_sp)) + 1]),\n",
    "        text = sprintf('%.3f', vals_m),\n",
    "        textposition = 'auto',\n",
    "        hovertemplate = paste0('<b>%{y}</b><br>', sp_lbl, '<br>', m_col, ': %{x:.3f}<extra></extra>')\n",
    "      )\n",
    "    }\n",
    "  }\n",
    "  n_sp <- length(sp_groups)\n",
    "  btns_comp <- lapply(seq_along(metrics_comp), function(m_idx) {\n",
    "    vis <- rep(FALSE, length(metrics_comp) * n_sp)\n",
    "    idx_range <- ((m_idx - 1) * n_sp + 1):(m_idx * n_sp)\n",
    "    vis[idx_range] <- TRUE\n",
    "    list(method = 'restyle', args = list('visible', as.list(vis)), label = paste('Métrica:', metrics_comp[m_idx]))\n",
    "  })\n",
    "  fig_comp %>% plotly::layout(\n",
    "    title = list(text = '<b>Comparativa Multiespecie según Escala del Genoma (Cromosómico vs. Contigs)</b>', x = 0.5),\n",
    "    barmode = 'group',\n",
    "    xaxis = list(title = 'Puntaje (0 a 1)', range = c(0, 1.08)),\n",
    "    yaxis = list(title = ''),\n",
    "    legend = list(orientation = 'h', y = -0.10, x = 0.5, xanchor = 'center'),\n",
    "    margin = list(l = 190, r = 30, t = 85, b = 100),\n",
    "    updatemenus = list(list(type = 'dropdown', active = 0, x = 0, y = 1.10, xanchor = 'left', buttons = btns_comp))\n",
    "  )\n",
    "}\n",
    sprintf("%s\n\n", bt3),
    "<details ontoggle=\"if(this.open){setTimeout(function(){window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); if(window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable){jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({visible:true, api:true}).columns.adjust();}}, 60);}\">\n",
    "<summary class=\"summary-btn\">📋 Ver Tabla Comparativa Multiespecie Completa</summary>\n\n",
    sprintf("%s{r table_multispecies_all, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}\n", bt3),
    "if (nrow(df_multiespecie_all) > 0) {\n",
    "  format_benchmark_dt(df_multiespecie_all, other_df = NULL, caption_text = 'Tabla Consolidada Multiespecie (Donante S. torvum + Especies Validadas a Escala Cromosómica y Escala de Contigs)')\n",
    "}\n",
    sprintf("%s\n\n</details>\n\n", bt3)
  )

  sp_tabs_md <- c(sp_tabs_md, comp_tab_md, ":::\n")
  res_all_md <- knitr::knit_child(
    text = paste(sp_tabs_md, collapse = "\n"),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  cat(res_all_md, sep = "\n")
}
```
